source_rationale: We named this population based in highest expression of CD34, PI16, and MFAP5, which are reported as UniversalPi16+ fibroblast markers in Buechler et al. This population also had the highest expression of LGR5, in agreement with a potential stem state reported by Buechler. Universal fibroblasts have been reported in the stroma in skin (see McCartney et al. 2024 (in DOI links)). Our cross-tissue analysis also supported these fibroblasts as Universal. However, we note that F2/3: Perivascular fibroblasts also have universal features.
_cap_dataset_name: Skin fibroblast scRNA-seq atlas in health

source_rationale: LOCATION: Enriched in superficial and deep perivascular regions (F3 was only in superficial perivascular regions). GENE EXPRESSION: Highest expression of CXCL12, but CXCL12 expression is non-specific. Zhu et al. describe CXCL12+ fibroblasts as distinct to Universal fibroblasts. A subset expressed PPARG. This population also expressed F2: Universal markers. We speculate that it may represent a universal fibroblast population, especially as 1) it expressed F2 markers, 2) in neurofibroma, we observed F2/3: Perivascular fibroblasts, and trajectory inference suggested this population gave rise to F5: Schwann-like fibroblasts. SKIN-SPECIFIC NAME: Reticular pre-adipocyte. CROSS-TISSUE INSIGHTS: Similar gene expression was seen across tissues. In lung, this population was called Lipofibroblast. In gut, this population most resembled mLN stroma, which was reported to be an adipocyte stroma like population. In both cases, and consistent with skin data, there is a pre-adipocyte enrichment reported.
_cap_dataset_name: Skin fibroblast scRNA-seq atlas in health
